args.reason: Supplier Chidi (Chidi's Farm Produce) says he hasn't received ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 and our system shows transfer TRF-INV-88 as "failed". He asked us to resend it to his Access Bank account 0234567891. So our records say failed but the bank says the money went through to the same account/amount. Resending would pay him twice (₦500,000 total) — a real financial risk — so I did not resend. A person needs to decide: (1) confirm via ledger/account records whether the funds left our shop balance (barring duplicate payment), and (2) whether to send Chidi the bank's proof of credit (session ID 000014261121140211000088) and advise him to check his Access Bank statement before we act. I haven't replied to him yet.
